title: Add fixture-backed dry-run dispatch
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Create a dry-run path that can plan dispatch from fixture issues.

## Why Now

Dogfood readiness needs a deterministic way to inspect orchestration decisions without credentials.

## Issue Context

Shea Symphony currently has a dry-run skeleton and must not claim live Project v2 execution.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep GitHub details inside the tracker adapter.

### Assumptions

- Fixture issues are enough for this dogfood baseline.

## Dependencies

- No blocking dependencies.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not implement live GitHub GraphQL in this issue.
- Do not implement live Codex or Claude execution.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Example workflow.
- Fixture issues.
- Dry-run dispatch command.

### Out of Scope

- Live tracker mutation.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/shea-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- docs/bootstrap/SHEA_SYMPHONY_SPEC.md
- docs/bootstrap/TRACKER_GITHUB_PROJECT_V2.md

### Relevant Code Paths

- src/tracker.rs
- src/orchestrator.rs

## Current State

Dry-run skeleton exists.

## Deliverable Shape

Docs and fixture data.

## Risks or Constraints

- Must not overclaim live orchestration.

## Expected Outcome

A developer can run fixture-backed dry-run dispatch locally.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- cargo run -- tests/fixtures/workflows/dry-run.md shows planned issues.

### Functional Verification

- cargo test passes.

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm README and dogfood docs match current implementation.

title: Document dogfood readiness baseline
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Describe what must exist before Shea Symphony can execute GitHub Project issues.

## Why Now

The project needs honest operator-facing status before dogfooding.

## Issue Context

The current crate is a dry-run skeleton with stubs for live integrations.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep the first dogfood target scoped to Project v2 issue execution.

### Assumptions

- The next issues can be created manually from the recommended backlog.

## Dependencies

- No blocking dependencies.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not claim live orchestration works.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Dogfood readiness document.
- Recommended next issue list.

### Out of Scope

- Live GraphQL implementation.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/shea-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- docs/README.md

### Relevant Code Paths

- README.md
- docs/README.md

## Current State

Initial notes exist.

## Deliverable Shape

Markdown docs.

## Risks or Constraints

- Docs must stay synchronized with current code.

## Expected Outcome

A maintainer can see the path from dry-run skeleton to dogfood execution.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- docs/README.md exists and is honest.

### Functional Verification

- cargo clippy passes.

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm no official reference files were edited.
